youtube.title: Check your robots.txt for Meta's crawlers with AI
youtube.description:
Meta has moved its website-crawling terms to 20 November 2026. James and Hannah show how to hand two jobs to AI, a robots.txt check across your ad domains and a one-page re-brief for legal. In both, a person still makes the decision.

Full episode and article: https://manual-focus.co.uk/blog/meta-crawling-terms-delay-uk-advertisers/
Listen on Apple Podcasts or Spotify. Search for Manual Focus.
The voices are AI-generated. James's is a clone of his own voice.

clips.linkedin:
Give AI your Meta ad domains and it will check each robots.txt and draft the lines you are missing.

Meta has moved its crawling terms to 20 November 2026, but the licence is unchanged, so the robots.txt plan stands. The extra weeks are enough to do the check properly.

Give your assistant the domains linked from your Meta ads. It reads each robots.txt, reports whether Meta-ExternalAgent is blocked and WebIndexer still allowed, then drafts the missing lines. Someone on the web team decides and deploys them.

The podcast voices are AI-generated, and mine is a clone of my own voice. We also cover a second job, a one-page re-brief for legal.

Full episode and article at https://manual-focus.co.uk/blog/meta-crawling-terms-delay-uk-advertisers/
clips.text: Get AI on this. First job, the robots.txt check across every domain linked to your Meta ads. Give it the list of domains from your Meta ads, catalogues and Business Suite. It reads each site's robots.txt and tells you, site by site, whether Meta-ExternalAgent is blocked and whether WebIndexer and the link previewer are still allowed, then drafts the lines you're missing. Someone on the web team decides and deploys them. Second, get AI on the legal re-brief. Give it the old UK wording from our first piece, the new wording and your licence types, photography, creator and reviews. It hands back a one-page note for legal showing what changed, what didn't, and the questions to ask about develop and research. Legal makes the call.
